إصدار تصريح عمل وأمر شغل مع حمل العاملين بالموقع كارت فئة 
السلامة والصحة المهنية

تسوير مكان 
العمل ووضع لافتات التحذيرية المناسبة

ضرورة استخدام 
 مهمات السلامة والصحة المهنية

تأكد من فصل 
مصدرى التغذية عن الخط المراد العمل عليه وتأريضه 
من كلا الجانبين
 وتأريض 
 قبل وبعد منطقة عمل الوصلة

تأكد من سلامة 
 الأدوات المستخدمة في عمل الوصلة قبل البدء في العمل (الحبل 
 ، المكبس ، القفزان 
 Grips
 ، السرافيل ، المقص الحدادي 
 ، البكارات)

الالتزام بالمواصفات الفنية السليمة في عمل الوصلة نظرا لتعرضها لقوي شد قد 
تؤثر على متانتها وبالتالي تعرض الأفراد لمخاطر قطع الموصلات وسقوطها بشكل عشوائي

في حالة وجود مساعد 
 أسفل البرج يراعي عدم 
 وقوفه أسفل البرج مباشرة حرصا على عدم 
 سقوط أي من الأدوات عليه

يراعي الالتزام بارتداء حزام 
 الأمان وتثبيته بالبرج بشكل جيد مع مراعاة الخلوص 
 المناسب لحرية الحركة

ارضى متنقل 
، مبين جهد

مهمات السلامة والصحة المهنية مثل خوذة 
أمان وحزام أمان 000الخ
سرافيل الومنيوم بمقاسات مختلفة

كووس 
 الومنيوم بمقاسات مختلفة ،
 كووس نحاس بمقاسات مختلفة 
 فى حالة السلك النحاس

طقم لقم (بمقاسات مختلفة ومناسبة 
 لمساحة مقطع الكوسة)، 
 رتش

طقم مفكات بمقاسات مختلفة ، طقم مفاتيح (بلدي مشرر) 
 ، زردية أو بنسة لفك اكسسوارات العازلات

كلمبات ، كلابة 
 Grip
 ، حبل ، 
 مجموعة بكرات 
 لسحب الموصلات

مكبس 
 ، مسامير قلاووظ بالورد للتثبيت

مقص حدادي ، شحم كهربي 
، فازلين ، 
 أدوات للتنظيف قبل الكبس (كهنة) 
 ، مادة للتنظيف (بوتاسا كاوية)
قم بإزالة الزيادة في طول الموصل ليكون بطول مناسب
نظف طرف الموصل الذي سيتم كبسة داخل الكوسه مع وضع فازلين خفيف

ادخل طرف الموصل داخل 
 الكوسة من نفس مساحة مقطع الموصل مع مراعاة لف الكوسة في نفس اتجاه جدل الموصل

اضغط الكوسة بالمكبس الهيدروليكي مع مراعاة استخدام لقم الكبس المناسبة لمساحة 
 مقطع الكوسة
 اعمل 
 ضغطتين على الكوسة مع مراعاة البدء بالضغطة الأولي من ناحية طرف التثبيت ثم 
 الضغطة الثانية على حافة الكوسة

rows: Maintenance Procedures Information System
Overhead Lines
Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: TL-045-r0a
Equipment: Medium-voltage overhead lines
Issued to: Distribution Companies
Status: Approved
Approval date: 12 February 2006
Procedure: Fitting the dead-end joint
Next review date: February 2011

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for fitting the dead-end joint on medium-voltage lines. It was prepared by the Minya Electricity Distribution Sector, Middle Egypt Electricity Distribution Company, and discussed, amended and approved by the MPIS coordinators of the electricity distribution companies.

rows: Issue a work permit and a work order, with the workers on site carrying an occupational safety and health category card.
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
The occupational safety and health equipment must be used.
Make sure both sources of supply are disconnected from the line to be worked on and that it is earthed from both sides, and earthed before and after the joint work area.
Make sure the tools used for making the joint are sound before starting work (rope, press, grips, ferrules, steel cutter, pulleys).

Observe the correct technical specifications when making the joint, since it is exposed to tensile forces that may affect its strength and consequently expose personnel to the risk of conductors breaking and falling randomly.
If there is an assistant below the tower, he must not stand directly below the tower, to avoid any tool falling on him.
Take care to wear the safety belt and fix it well to the tower, observing the appropriate clearance for freedom of movement.
Portable earth, voltage indicator.
Occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety belt, etc.
Aluminium ferrules of different sizes.
Aluminium lugs of different sizes, copper lugs of different sizes in the case of copper wire.
Die set (of different sizes suitable for the lug cross-sectional area), ratchet.
Screwdriver set of different sizes, spanner set (open-end and ring), pliers for removing insulator accessories.
Clamps, grip, rope, a set of pulleys for pulling the conductors.
Press, threaded bolts with washers for fixing.
Steel cutter, electrical grease, Vaseline, cleaning tools before compression (rags), cleaning material (caustic potash).

sections_en.text: Procedures to be Carried Out (Figure No. 1)

rows: Remove the excess conductor length so that it is of a suitable length.
Clean the conductor end to be compressed inside the lug, applying light Vaseline.
Insert the conductor end inside the lug of the same conductor cross-sectional area, taking care to rotate the lug in the same direction as the lay of the conductor.

Compress the lug with the hydraulic press, taking care to use the compression dies suitable for the lug cross-sectional area. Make two compressions on the lug, starting with the first compression from the fixing end side, then the second compression on the edge of the lug.

Introduction
This document sets out the steps for fitting the dead-end joint on medium-voltage lines. It was prepared by the Minya Electricity Distribution Sector, Middle Egypt Electricity Distribution Company, and discussed, amended and approved by the MPIS coordinators of the electricity distribution companies.
Safety Precautions
Issue a work permit and a work order, with the workers on site carrying an occupational safety and health category card. | 
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs. | 
The occupational safety and health equipment must be used. | 
Make sure both sources of supply are disconnected from the line to be worked on and that it is earthed from both sides, and earthed before and after the joint work area. | 
Make sure the tools used for making the joint are sound before starting work (rope, press, grips, ferrules, steel cutter, pulleys). | 
Observe the correct technical specifications when making the joint, since it is exposed to tensile forces that may affect its strength and consequently expose personnel to the risk of conductors breaking and falling randomly. | 
If there is an assistant below the tower, he must not stand directly below the tower, to avoid any tool falling on him. | 
Take care to wear the safety belt and fix it well to the tower, observing the appropriate clearance for freedom of movement. | 
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Portable earth, voltage indicator. | 
Occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety belt, etc. | 
Aluminium ferrules of different sizes. | 
Aluminium lugs of different sizes, copper lugs of different sizes in the case of copper wire. | 
Die set (of different sizes suitable for the lug cross-sectional area), ratchet. | 
Screwdriver set of different sizes, spanner set (open-end and ring), pliers for removing insulator accessories. | 
Clamps, grip, rope, a set of pulleys for pulling the conductors. | 
Press, threaded bolts with washers for fixing. | 
Steel cutter, electrical grease, Vaseline, cleaning tools before compression (rags), cleaning material (caustic potash). | 
Procedures to be Carried Out (Figure No. 1)
Remove the excess conductor length so that it is of a suitable length. | 1.
Clean the conductor end to be compressed inside the lug, applying light Vaseline. | 2.
Insert the conductor end inside the lug of the same conductor cross-sectional area, taking care to rotate the lug in the same direction as the lay of the conductor. | 3.
Compress the lug with the hydraulic press, taking care to use the compression dies suitable for the lug cross-sectional area. Make two compressions on the lug, starting with the first compression from the fixing end side, then the second compression on the edge of the lug. | 4. 5.
